newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ING syndicates loan for Philippine power firm.
newsitem.headline: ING syndicates loan for Philippine power firm.

text.p: ING Barings had syndicated a $23 million loan to a power company based in the southern Philippines, ING Bank Manila said on Thursday.
The loan, which was syndicated with four other foreign banks, is to refinance the existing term debts of Northern Mindanao Power Corp.
Other members of the syndicate are Standard Chartered Bank, the Development Bank of Singapore and Kredietbank NV.
The loan is payable over five years.
Northern Mindanao, which operates two diesel-fired power plants with a combined generating capacity of 103 megawatts, is partly owned by Japan's Tomen Corp and the local Alcantara Group.
